_doc: game modes (milestone 16, src/sim/modes.gd), the first of the match rules (milestone 18): the host's rules carry `mode` (an id here; none or standard: the usual match), applied at World setup after the usual start. A mode gives every side (or, with defend/attack, the defending team: player 0's, and the rest) a start: age (the ages up to it are given), stock (resources set, not added), town (false: no Town Center or starting workers; such a side is out once it has nothing left), workers (more workers by the Town Center), walls (a finished ring round its start: Fortify, src/sim/fortify.gd: radius, wall, gate, tower, tower_every, gates), garrison (soldiers by slot, put up on the walkway facing the nearest enemy start), army (soldiers and engines by slot, by its start). hold_minutes (defend/attack): the defenders win when it runs out. lift_lacks: buildings every side may build and repair in this mode whatever its race lacks in a normal match (the walls: Dominic, 2026-10-13)

standard.name: Standard
standard.desc: The usual match: a Town Center and a few workers each.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.desc: Every side starts in age 2 behind a stone ring with gatehouses and wall towers, archers on the walls and a fat stockpile for siege. Break in, hold out.

siege.name: Siege
siege.desc: The first side holds a walled town in age 3; the others come with an army and engines but no town. Take the Town Center, or hold out for 20 minutes.
